HowTo.heading: How does the Shoebox Campaign work?
HowTo.headingSub: Donate and let's create a Christmas miracle together!
HowTo.stepDonate: Donate: Give the boxes you have put together, so they reach the children who need them most.
HowTo.stepHappy: Share the joy: See the happy faces of the children as they unwrap their gifts! A simple shoebox can bring so much joy.
HowTo.stepMakeBox: Pack a box: Anyone can take part! Fill a shoebox with useful and cheerful things such as toys, stationery, clothes or sweets.

MainContentGroup.attention: We all know how much a little attention, love and care can brighten a child's day. That is exactly the goal of our annual Shoebox Campaign: to bring joy and hope to children in need. This is already its 7th year, and in that time nearly 13,000 children have received a gift.
MainContentGroup.community: Being part of the campaign feels good, because it is not only about giving — it is also about belonging. Join the Grenzenlose Kinderhilfe community, where we work together to bring happiness to the lives of as many children as possible.
MainContentGroup.shoeboxMagic: Would you have thought that a simple shoebox could work magic? And create children's smiles, too! With our charity campaign, we aim to bring happy moments to as many children in need as possible during the holidays at the end of the year.
MainContentGroup.titleHeadingSub: Donate and let's create a Christmas miracle together!

aboutUs.contentHeader: The question was simple: what do you need? <1></1>The answer was even simpler: care.<3></3>That is where our story began.
aboutUs.contentText: <0>In 2010 we attended a Christmas event at a children's home, where children with disabilities put on a truly heartfelt show for us, the “healthy” ones. Moved by what we felt that day, we began looking for ways to thank the children and adults who had given us those indescribably good feelings. The question was simple: what do you need? The answer was even simpler: care.</0><1>That is where our story began. Over the past years, we have managed time and again to put a smile on the faces of children, with and without disabilities, through the programmes and surprises we have come up with and organised for them!</1><2>Over the years, acquaintances, friends and countless strangers have joined our team with the wish to help. Together we have been — and still are — enthusiastically preparing to serve, in many different ways, the children growing up as orphans, in disadvantaged circumstances or in institutional care in Hungary, Romania and Ukraine, for whom everyday happiness is in short supply!</2><3>For us, “the smile of children” matters a great deal! This care is one of the ways love shows itself! Whether a child is healthy, or a little person with superhuman strength who can play the piano beautifully despite missing legs and fingers — it is for them and because of them that we founded the Határtalan Segítség Foundation! Here you can read about our programmes and celebrations so far, and by taking part in person you can shape the events to come!</3><4>Thank you for your interest — enjoy browsing the website. We look forward to your involvement, because now you know: every child's smile counts!</4>

mission.educationContent: Learning through play matters most to curious children. Carefree play together helps the residents of the homes grow, and the shared experiences do both the little ones and the donors good. That is why we value bringing generations together, the chance to learn from one another, and giving children the right tools. From coloured pencils to computers, from arts and crafts to language learning — everything serves the development of those in need! Donate used or new equipment yourself, so that orphaned children can start life with equal opportunities!
mission.experiencesContent: Being able to give and receive shared experiences as members of a community is a basic human need. Children living in homes grow up in a less stimulating environment, so it is a great joy for them when visitors come for a shared activity or game, or when they are invited somewhere themselves. The greatest adventure for them is a leisure activity together: games, excursions, baking and cooking, ice cream, cycling! Give the children experiences, too!
mission.infrastructureContent: There is hardly any funding for improving children's homes; operators are glad if they can simply meet the regulations. Most of them are housed in outdated buildings with old furniture and equipment, and modernisation is a real headache for the people who run them. In most cases even repainting is only possible thanks to volunteers. Our plans include installing solar collectors, which would greatly help with the hot water supply — but in most places the kitchen equipment and other appliances, such as washing machines and dryers, also need replacing. Almost everywhere, the children's beds and furniture should be replaced as well. To this end, we launched a programme that aimed to fully re-equip and expand 80 homes by the end of 2018.
mission.transporationContent: “The journey is the destination.” There is no more exciting feeling than getting ready for a trip. For orphaned children, a trip abroad — or any trip at all — is a very big dream. Sadly, we have seen this again and again over the years when talking to the children. So it was almost obvious that we should organise trips for them. Giving this feeling of freedom to the children living in the homes is a wonderful experience! Travelling together recharges everyone! Our plans also include a transport vehicle and setting up a holiday centre in Austria! Give the orphans the gift of travel, a summer camp or winter adventures!

home.missionStatement: <0>Our most important goal is to brighten the everyday lives of orphaned children in the Carpathian Basin!</0><1>Our first charity campaign was started by friends at Christmas 2011, when we gave gifts to children in need. Seeing their faces light up, we knew we wanted to do it again — and not just once a year.</1><2>The children in the homes welcome the gifts, the shared activities and the donors with enormous love. We aim to give in a way that fits the particular situation of each institution, so our programmes have kept growing and changing from the very beginning until today.</2><3>We are constantly re-planning and setting new goals, guided by the needs of our volunteer donors, the children and the institutions.</3>
